title: pv-LazoDiscs
description: Server-side custom music discs using Plasmo Voice positional audio.
body:
# LazoDiscs

**LazoDiscs** is a server-side NeoForge mod that lets players burn custom audio links onto vanilla Minecraft music discs and play them through **Plasmo Voice** positional audio.

The mod itself is designed to run on the **server only**.
Players do **not** need LazoDiscs on the client, but they still need **Plasmo Voice** installed to hear the audio.

## Features

* Burn custom audio links onto vanilla music discs
* Play custom discs through **Plasmo Voice** positional audio
* Separate Plasmo Voice source line for disc volume control
* Search for songs from in-game chat
* Clickable chat search results
* Search page switching with chat arrows
* Direct MP3 link support
* YouTube / YouTube Music support
* SoundCloud support
* Spotify links supported through metadata/search matching
* Sable / Create Aeronautics moving platform position support
* No external programs required: no yt-dlp, no spotDL, no ffmpeg

## Commands

```mcfunction
/lazodiscs burn <url> [title]
/lazodiscs clear
/lazodiscs search "<song name>"
```

## How to use

Hold a vanilla music disc in your main hand and run:

```mcfunction
/lazodiscs burn "https://example.com/song.mp3" My Song
```

Then put the disc into a jukebox.

The audio will play through **Plasmo Voice**, so nearby players hear it as positional audio.

## Song search

You can search for songs directly from chat:

```mcfunction
/lazodiscs search "song name"
```

Search results appear in chat.
Click a song title to automatically fill the burn command.

Search pages can be switched using chat arrows:

```text
◀  Page 1/4  ▶
```

## Spotify note

Spotify links are not played directly, because normal Spotify track links do not provide direct audio streams.

LazoDiscs reads Spotify metadata when possible and then searches for a matching track through YouTube Music.

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge
* Plasmo Voice

Plasmo Voice links:

* Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/plugin/plasmo-voice
* GitHub: https://github.com/plasmoapp/plasmo-voice
* CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/plasmo-voice

## Environment

* Server: Required
* Client: Not required
* Client still needs Plasmo Voice to hear audio

## Compatibility

Made for:

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge
* Plasmo Voice
* Sable / Create Aeronautics physics assemblies
